description: This file defines the interface `IEventHandler` within the `WPEFramework::Plugin` namespace. It declares four pure virtual methods meant to handle different types of events, each accepting parameters related to event data. The file includes licensing information, include guards, and necessary includes.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Abstract interface class defining event handler methods for runtime, window, ripple, and state change events.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events with provided JSON data.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events with provided JSON data.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events identified by name with associated JSON data.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events with provided JSON data.
